newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai suggests 3 areas for foreign investment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai suggests 3 areas for foreign investment.

text.p: Shanghai wants overseas investors to concentrate on processing, infrastructure and real estate projects in the city which will be the most profitable sectors for foreigners, the Business News said on Monday.

The paper said the processing industry was a traditional trade in Shanghai but equipment had become out-dated and management was relatively poor, leaving room for foreigners to invest and make profits.
Opportunity was also present in the field of infrastructure construction for which Shanghai lacked funds, the paper said.
In the coming years, a number of key projects, including Pudong international airport, a city-wide computer information network and an outer ring road would offer many chances, it said.
The paper said development of low-priced homes in Shanghai had lagged behind the city's overall development for the past few years and overseas investors could make use of the gap.
